name: cut-lockup
title: Cut Lockup
description: Logo reveal in hard cuts. The logo lands huge on grid paper, steps down in three cuts, pushes in, cuts to night where its construction lines and anchor points draw themselves, then a paper panel wipes up onto the resting lockup. Cuts, scales, push and wipe are measured frame by frame off a reference recording.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/cut-lockup?ref=cli — 108 frames at 30fps; paints its own background. Pass your logo as SVG paths (logo={{ width, height, shapes }}). — 76 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
